status: Reconstructed V17 cinematic implementation; not the lost original shader
density_structure: Eighteen unequal overlapping formation envelopes, coherent low frequency warp, broad billows, boundary weighted finer erosion, continuous density transition; curved separate cloud bases and no plane
lighting: Direct directional illumination with HG-like angular response, two optical-depth-dependent approximate scattering lobes, cool height-dependent fill, common sun/sky colors, fixed exposure and smooth highlight shoulder
camera: Smooth forward approach from z=-9 to z=27, three-unit lateral bend into a thin fringe, then early retreat from the right-hand wall and rising reveal to y=26.2; pitch opens the lower cloud field at the end
revision_notes: Second visual iteration: narrower continuous density boundary preserves erosion detail, deeper blue sky and reduced scattering fill restore contrast, camera clears nearby wall earlier and rises above the cloud field

offline_interface.shade: vec3 shade(vec3 p,vec3 rd,float d,float sunTau)
offline_interface.camera: void camera(float time,out vec3 ro,out vec3 rd,vec2 fragCoord)

limitations: Analytic cloud appearance; no moisture, buoyancy or fluid solver
Static density field; movement is the camera
Multiple scattering is approximated, not path traced
Offline density interpolation and cached sunlight must be documented by the renderer
